title: A cleared carry leaves a word unchanged
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $\mathrm{top}:\Gamma\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and $\mathrm{next}:\Gamma\to\Gamma$ be functions, and let $w$ be a finite string over $\Gamma$. Scanning $w$ with the carry rule that, when the carry is true, outputs $\mathrm{top}(\gamma)$ and replaces $\gamma$ by $\mathrm{next}(\gamma)$, and when the carry is false, outputs false and leaves $\gamma$ unchanged, starting with carry false returns carry false and leaves the entire string unchanged.
